displayTitle: Roleplaying Game: Geonosis And The Outer Rim Worlds
synopsis: Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds is a sourcebook for the Star Wars Roleplaying Game published by Wizards of the Coast on March 24, 2004.The book covers historical and major character information related to 26 planets of the Outer Rim Territories including Geonosis, Kamino, Ryloth, and Kessel.
title: Star Wars Roleplaying Game: Geonosis And The Outer Rim Worlds
